title: Universal property of the localization at the powers of an element
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f\in R$, and $R_f$ the localization of $R$ at $\{1,f,f^2,\dots\}$ with its map $R\to R_f$, $a\mapsto a/1$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Let $g:R\to P$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $g(f)$ is a unit of $P$. Then there is a unique ring homomorphism $\bar g:R_f\to P$ with $\bar g(a/1)=g(a)$ for all $a\in R$; it is given by $\bar g(a/f^n)=g(a)\,g(f)^{-n}$. In particular two ring homomorphisms $R_f\to P$ that agree on all $a/1$, $a\in R$, are equal.
